A Practical Reseller Sourcing Checklist

A repeatable pre-purchase screen for price, condition, demand, and risk.

A good sourcing check is short enough to use in the field and strict enough to prevent hopeful purchases.

  1. Identify the exact item, model, size, and condition.
  2. Check credible sold-price evidence where available.
  3. Estimate a conservative selling price.
  4. Confirm category restrictions and shipping practicality.
  5. Enter every expected cost.
  6. Calculate net profit, margin, ROI, and maximum buy price.
  7. Allow a buffer for negotiation and surprises.
  8. Pass when the numbers depend on a best-case outcome.

Use the maximum buy price calculator before purchasing, then record the assumptions you used so you can compare estimates with actual results later.

Keep the estimate honest.

Fee structures and actual costs can change. Verify the rules that apply to your sale and treat every result as planning information.
